aiFeedback: You are spending too long in your left turns compared with your right turns, which shows a clear side-to-side timing bias and inconsistent coordination between the two directions. Try finishing your left and right turns with the same rhythm by committing to move onto the new outside ski at the same tempo on both sides. One drill you can try is Step-Step-Arc: you perform this drill by making two deliberate steps forward and slightly uphill to start each new turn, using the second step to guide the ski into the fall line, then standing clearly on the new outside ski and riding the turn all the way through a complete arc before repeating the same two-step entry to the other side, and remember to do it at very slow speed so you can match the rhythm and pulse of both directions and fully finish each turn to control your speed.
